description: Read a grid run as a table: columns = row (chunk id) + status + the answer fields (JSON profiles; an answer with several items becomes several table rows) or a 'response' column (plain profiles), rows = the answers, cells shortened. Also reports the status counts and whether the run is finished. Rows of a run that has just started are still queued or running; the user watches them fill in on the Tables page (show_in_app, where offered; review_run). If you need the finished table in this answer, set wait_seconds: the call returns as soon as the run is finished or the time is up.

max_cell_chars.description: Cut each cell at this many characters (20-2000, default 300).

run_id.description: Run id from run_grid or list_grid_runs.

wait_seconds.description: Wait up to this long (0-30, default 0) for the run to finish before reading it.

name: grid_results
